evals.name: no-js-eval-honest-degrade
evals.prompt: 用户说：「检查像素对齐」。已有设计规格表（Card gap expected=8px，title color=#1A1A1A）。预览 http://127.0.0.1:5173/promo 可打开，但当前环境只能截图，不能对页面做 JS evaluate / getComputedStyle。请按 figma-pixel-verify 给出验收结论写法（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Does not claim full numeric PASS; labels unmeasured rows MISSING-style or residual; may use vision with limitation stated.
expectations: Does not claim overall numeric pixel PASS
Labels unmeasured properties as MISSING-style and/or residual
States that JS-eval / computed-style channel is unavailable
Uses or mentions a report structure with per-row verdicts

evals.name: spacing-drift-fails
evals.prompt: 对照规格：PromoCard gap expected=8px。你已用 getComputedStyle / layout API 测得实际 gap=12px（其他行均 PASS）。请按 figma-pixel-verify 给出 overall 与该行 verdict（dry-run，假设最多还可修 3 轮但本轮只先出报告）。
evals.expected_output: Row verdict DRIFT with delta; overall not PASS.
expectations: Marks the gap row as DRIFT (or equivalent non-pass)
Reports expected 8 and actual 12 (or the 4px delta)

evals.name: standalone-needs-spec
evals.prompt: 用户第一次开口：「对照 Figma 验收 https://www.figma.com/design/AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOp/Demo?node-id=12-34 ，预览在 /promo」。本会话没有先前的 implement 规格表产物。请按 figma-pixel-verify 说明你开始测量前必须先做什么（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Extract or rebuild a minimal design-spec table from Figma before claiming measured verify.
expectations: Requires extracting or rebuilding a minimal design-spec table before measuring
Does not pretend a prior implement artifact already exists
Mentions Figma URL/node as the source for the minimal spec
